dedupe_keys.name: city of melbourne 3d textured mesh photomesh 2020

description: City of Melbourne publishes a 3D textured mesh of all physical features, such as buildings, trees and terrain, across the City of Melbourne, provided as Esri scene layer packages and as OBJ files with material and image texture files, split into tiles that cover the municipality. Coverage: the City of Melbourne municipality, Australia; captured in May 2020 at 2 cm ground sample distance, in the MGA zone 55 projection and the Australian Height Datum, record last modified on 2024-04-02. Format and access: SLPK, OBJ, MTL, JPG, downloadable without registration from the City of Melbourne open data portal. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC BY; cost: free. Caveats: the mesh is a visual surface without building semantics; the portal record has no tabular rows (the tiles are downloaded from links on the page), and the tile sizes were not checked; earlier 2018 photomesh and elevation models are separate records. Simulation uses: detailed geometry for city digital twins, solar and shading studies, and visual validation of building and terrain models. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
name: City of Melbourne: 3D textured mesh (photomesh), 2020
